title: Turkish-Style Keto Kofte Meatballs
description: A low-carb twist on traditional Turkish kofte, made with ground meat and spices, served with a side of fresh lettuce.

ingredients.name: Ground Cig Sausage
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a low-carb sausage option

ingredients.name: Airy Feta Cheese
ingredients.notes: Optional but recommended for added flavor

ingredients.name: Cig Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine the ground sausage, feta cheese (if using), and spice mix.
3. Mix well with your hands until just combined. Be careful not to overmix.
4. Use your hands to shape the mixture into small meatballs, about 1 1/2 inches (3.8 cm) in diameter.
5. Place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Drizzle with olive oil and gently roll to coat evenly.
7. Bake in the preheated oven for 18-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
8. While the meatballs are baking, prepare the lettuce by washing and drying it.
9. Serve the meatballs hot on top of a bed of fresh lettuce.
10. Optional: drizzle with additional olive oil and serve with your favorite sides, such as a side salad or roasted vegetables.
